subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw support non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup, and what handoff contract is acceptable for callback or token material?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but the safe contract affects auth-provider behavior, secret exposure, env/config surface, and alignment with upstream Codex OAuth semantics, so implementation should wait for maintainer intent.

options.title: Provider-owned validated handoff
options.body: Design a narrow OpenAI-provider OAuth handoff/import contract that validates PKCE/state or equivalent token provenance, redacts sensitive material, and covers non-interactive setup with docs and tests.

options.title: Accept callback-url env contract
options.body: Implement the requested environment-variable callback URL path with strict validation/redaction, accepting the new env surface and support burden as product policy.

options.title: Defer to existing setup paths
options.body: Keep browser OAuth, device-code, and API-key setup as the supported non-interactive/headless alternatives and close or defer this feature.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned validated handoff
recommendation.body: Design a narrow OpenAI-provider OAuth handoff/import contract that validates PKCE/state or equivalent token provenance, redacts sensitive material, and covers non-interactive setup with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent OpenAI provider identity and onboarding/auth work is the strongest available history signal for this product/security choice.
